test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four words have been given out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 
• Field, mountain, and valley are landforms.
 
• So, air is different from others.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
